payload.note: [llm audit] This is a static 0 K adsorption energy, so no MD settings apply. The protocol is complete: LBFGS to fmax 0.01 eV/Å, four sites screened, and slab size and coverage converged to under 0.01 eV at 4x4x5. The slab has a relaxed top region and 16 Å of total vacuum. MACE-MPA-0 is used on an inorganic Cu/O system, which is inside its training domain. The isolated-O-atom reference was checked against the model's O2 binding energy (6.28 eV, matching PBE), and the known PBE O2 overbinding is disclosed and covered by the ±0.5 eV uncertainty. A 1/2 O2 reference is also reported, so I cannot name a methodological flaw. [claude-opus-5-5, $0.0217]
